preconditions.description: The number of horses n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of enemy pairs m must be between 0 and 3 times the number of horses.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in enemy_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each enemy pair must consist of valid horse indices and must not be the same horse.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid_partition else len(stdout) == n and all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: If a valid partition exists, the output must be a string of length n consisting of '0's and '1's; otherwise, it must be '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for j in range(n) if (i, j) in enemy_pairs and stdout[i] == stdout[j]) <= 1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each horse must have at most one enemy in its assigned party.
